title: Getting Started
subtitle: What MRU is and how to use this book

entries.title: Overview
entries.summary: How this book and the main line work

blocks.text: Scattered through all things, the radiance harms no one. The people of Hoanna gathered it and drove it to work, and then Hoanna burned. We gather it as well, and we drive it. These books set down how it is done. Where to stop, we have not yet learned.

The forebears called it <hl>MRU</hl>, the Magical Radiation Unit. It once burned a whole world; now it is shut up in crystals and coils, and it drives machines. EssentialCraft is about using machines to gather and store MRU, then spending it to run other machines and make magic gear. Think of MRU as this mod's electricity; see [[start/mru]].
Three parts to this book

items: <t>Getting Started</t>: the basic ideas and some quick-reference tables. Look here first when a word is new to you.

items.text: <t>Main line</t>: fifteen chapters that take you from digging up drops to moving items around, one step at a time. Most pages are steps and get a ✓ when done. A few are reference pages, with tables, rules or background, and have nothing to check off.

<t>Main line</t>: twenty-three chapters that take you from digging up drops all the way to the Inquisitorium, the Computer Guy's Suit and its modules, and finally to the Heart of Calamity, one step at a time. Most pages are steps and get a ✓ when done. A few are reference pages, with tables, rules or background, and have nothing to check off.

items: <t>Side chapters</t>: gear, devices, baubles, guns and more. They don't have to be read in order; build them whenever your main-line progress allows.

Step through the Gate to Hoanna, collapse an MRUCU, summon demons to trade with and raise the pentacle to tier 2, fight the Holographic Projection; decode a Glitchy Core, defeat the Inquisitorium Sentinel and raise the pentacle to tier 3, build the Computer Guy's Suit and finally fit it with modules

blocks.text: On a first playthrough, following the book, Chapters 1 to 15 take twenty-odd to thirty hours. The first real hurdle is the Nether, because from Chapter 2 on, soul sand, quartz and blaze powder all come from there.

The six chapters from Hoanna on take another seventy to a hundred hours, most of it spent waiting for ESPE to build up. The Inquisitorium chapter takes fifteen to twenty hours and comes right before the Computer Guy's Suit, so you have something to do while you wait. The machines that gather ESPE only work while their chunk is loaded, so stay nearby while they run. The whole main line comes to a little over a hundred hours; players who know the way need thirty-odd.

blocks.title: Where to start
blocks.text: Skim these Getting Started pages and read [[start/faq]] closely. Then turn to [[elements/book]] and follow the main line from there.

blocks.title: Played the original?
blocks.text: If you played EssentialCraft on 1.12, read [[from_ec4/overview|the appendix on changes from EC4]] first. Everything that was renamed, reworked or removed is listed there.
EssentialCraft began with Modbder and was later carried on by TheLMiffy1111 and others as "EssentialCraft 4 Unofficial". The mod this book belongs to is its port to 1.20.1.

<hl>MRU</hl> stands for Magical Radiation Unit. The people of Hoanna called its light radiance; the forebears renamed it MRU when they came to write it down, and the Fragments use both words. Every machine in this mod runs on it, and the table below shows where it comes from, how it moves and where it goes.

rows: Generators are machines that make MRU on their own. First you trade your own matrix for it, then you burn fuel, burn plants or draw on the cold
No pipes or wires. Put a Bound Gem in a machine that uses MRU and it pulls MRU through the air from a source within 16 blocks
Machines like the Radiating Chamber and Magician Table use it up as they work
Soul storage items are batteries you carry; staffs, charms and magic gear draw from them

blocks.text: Balance
Every bit of MRU carries a Balance between 0 and 2, shown in machine screens. It tells you whether that MRU runs "cold" or "wild".
Most machines ignore Balance. The ones that care are mainly a few Radiating Chamber recipes, such as [[generators/projections]], which only run while the Balance sits in a certain range.
Where Balance comes from

cells: Random 0–2 when placed; breaking and replacing rolls again
Random 0–2 when placed; breaking and replacing rolls again

blocks.text: Mixing
MRU that a machine pulls in mixes with what it already holds, weighted by amount, so the more a machine holds, the harder it is for new MRU to shift its Balance.

A machine holding 4,000 MRU (1.0) pulls in 1,000 MRU (0.2)
New Balance = (4,000 × 1.0 + 1,000 × 0.2) ÷ 5,000 = 0.84
The easiest way to get a machine onto a different Balance is to start with an empty one.

The original mod's research book describes MRU as a particle smaller than an electron, hidden in everything. It passes through matter like gamma rays, hence "radiation", and it can change what matter is, hence "magic". The book adds that MRU scattered through the world is calm and harmless, and stops being calm once it is gathered, compressed and driven.

blocks.caption: A lithium atom as imagined in the original research book: the nucleus in the middle, electrons in cyan, and the even tinier purple particle is MRU

blocks.text: An MRUCU (MRU cluster) is a floating clump of MRU, a ball of light shining in every direction. It grows as it fills, and its color follows its Balance: cyan for Pure, blue for Frozen, red for Chaos. One holds at most 20,000 MRU, and two that end up in the same block merge into one.

blocks.text: Where they come from

items: Machine leaks: machines like the Radiating Chamber and Magician Table leak MRU while they work. It flows into the nearest MRUCU within 32 blocks across and 16 up or down, or forms a new one beside the machine ([[crafting/corruption]]).
The diamond ritual: see below.
Ancient ruins: generated with the world; see below.

blocks.text: Past 10,000

Once an MRUCU holds 10,000 MRU, every second it adds matrix damage to players within 12 blocks, 40 points while it holds 10,000 to 20,000 and 80 points when it is full at 20,000. Creative mode is unaffected. Below 10,000 it is completely harmless.

Matrix damage doesn't wear off. Enough of it turns into corruption effects ([[corruption/matrix_damage]]), and only the [[pentacle/pentacle]] can cure them. Until you open your first finished pentacle the damage just builds up and forms nothing. After that every kind of effect can form, though it takes a lot of damage to make one.
Matrix damage doesn't wear off. Enough of it turns into permanent corruption effects ([[corruption/matrix_damage]]), and only the [[pentacle/pentacle]] can cure them.
Seeing, blocking and containing them

items: See: hold or wear a {item:essentialcraft5:magic_monocle} to see MRUCUs through walls ([[gear/magic_monocle]]).
Gauge it: an MRUCU shows no number, only rays whose length grows with what it holds. The longest ray reaches about 1 block out at 5,000, about 2 at 10,000 and about 4 when full at 20,000.
Move: use the {item:essentialcraft5:mru_mover} to carry one off to a corner you seldom visit ([[crafting/corruption]]).
Wall off: blocks between the MRUCU and you stop part of the damage, as the table below shows.
Armor up: a full set of MHS (Magical Hazmat Suit) armor cuts the damage per second from 40 / 80 to 1 / 3 ([[gear/mhs_armor]]).

Contain: the MRU stored in an Enrichment Chamber never hurts anyone. MRUCUs floating inside its shell, whether grown by leaky machines shut in there or moved in, stop hurting anyone once an {item:essentialcraft5:ec_balancer} is built into the shell ([[pentacle/ec_balancer]]).

rows: Enrichment Chamber parts such as the controller, acceptor and holding blocks

blocks.text: Only the strongest block on the line between the MRUCU and you counts, so stacking layers doesn't help. Platings are made in [[alloys/plating]].
The MRU Corruption effect

This is the first one in the table at the top. Each time a machine leaks, the machine's owner gets one more layer of "{lang:effect.essentialcraft5.mru_corruption}" if within 6 blocks across and 3 up or down. Only whoever placed the machine gets it; teammates, passers-by and neighbors never do.
This is the first one in the table at the top. Each time a machine leaks, players within 6 blocks across and 3 up or down get one more layer of "{lang:effect.essentialcraft5.mru_corruption}".

items: The first layer gives level I for 10 seconds; each layer after that adds 0.1 seconds.
When a layer is added, every full 100 seconds of remaining time is one more level.
From level II on, each second has a (level − 1)/16 chance of a magic hit worth {cfg:general.corruption.mru_corruption_health_percent|pct} of your max health, and MHS armor softens it.
It isn't a status effect, so instead of the top-right corner it shows as a purple-framed icon left of your hotbar, and milk, totems and cleansing can't remove it. It fades when you die.

blocks.text: Standing by one machine, the remaining time grows by about 1 second each second, reaching level II after about 90 seconds and level III after about 190. Once you leave, the level stays where it is and the effect ends when the time runs out.
The diamond ritual

Drop a {item:minecraft:diamond} on the same layout as the Soul Stone ritual and no item comes out. Each one instead has a 60% chance to pour 5,000 MRU into the nearest MRUCU within 32 blocks, or to form a new one right there if there is none. Two diamonds can bring one up to 10,000, so think it through before you drop diamonds here.
Ancient ruins

Ancient ruins are rare, about one per two or three hundred chunks, and most lie buried in Overworld stone between y 0 and 127. Each is a stone brick cage walled with iron bars, holding four dungeon chests and four spawners, with an MRUCU hanging in the middle. The forebears built these cages the way the people of Hoanna did, to hold MRUCUs that kept on growing. The occasional one out on the surface or in a cave is a stone brick platform, sometimes with chests.

The MRUCU in a ruin holds 5,000–10,000 MRU, just under the harmful line, but don't run machines next to it or their leaks will push it past 10,000. The chests hold the same loot as vanilla dungeons and may also turn up [[baubles/finding|special baubles]].

An MRU Golem guards the MRUCU. It wakes when you get within {cfg:general.mobs.mru_golem.trigger_radius} blocks and appears on the ground above the ruin. Early gear won't beat it ([[bestiary/mru_golem]]). Ruins generated before this update have no golem.

MRUCUs holding {cfg:general.mobs.matrix_wraith.min_presence_mru} MRU or more also draw [[bestiary/matrix_wraith|Matrix Wraiths]] into the dark around them, and the one in a ruin is big enough ([[corruption/matrix_damage]]).
In Hoanna, ancient ruins are far more common, about one every thirty-odd chunks ([[hoanna/lands]]).

entries.title: Common Mistakes
entries.summary: The traps new players fall into

blocks.text: MRU and UBMRU

items: Dying loses all your UBMRU, so turn it into MRU as soon as you have some ([[mru/ubmru]]).
Only your own kills give UBMRU. Arrows count; kills by pets or machines don't.
The Matrix Destructor only works while the Soul Stone's owner is online, so never hand a stone bound to you to someone else ([[mru/matrix_absorber]]).

blocks.text: Machines

items: Bound Gems have a range. The source must be in the same dimension, within 16 blocks along each axis, in a loaded chunk ([[crafting/bound_gem]]).
Every machine fills itself up first, so when several machines share one source, whichever pulls first hoards it.
Breaking a machine loses the MRU stored in it, though its items drop out.
A Heat Generator with air on any one side makes nothing ([[generators/heat_generator]]).
Old MRU in a Radiating Chamber holds its Balance back, so use an empty chamber for frozen and chaos projections ([[generators/projections]]).
A full output slot on the Magician Table resets its progress, so empty it in time.

Early machines stop when they get a redstone signal. That goes for the Matrix Destructor, Radiating Chamber, Magician Table, Heat Generator, Natural Furnace, Cold Distillator and Charging Chamber. If a machine sits idle, look for redstone nearby.
Machines in this mod never mine or place blocks for you, and never light fires ([[automation/rules]]).

blocks.text: Safety

items.text: Don't hang around a working Radiating Chamber or Magician Table, or you'll build up the MRU Corruption effect ([[crafting/corruption]]).

items: Don't let an MRUCU grow past 10,000. Past that it damages the matrix of players within 12 blocks ([[start/mrucu]]).
Only one bauble of each kind takes effect ([[baubles/finding]]).

blocks.text: Curios

items: Curios suddenly stop working and the slots show a sealed icon. Someone nearby is wearing the whole Computer Guy's Suit with the Curio Seal Field on; get more than {cfg:general.computer_seal.radius|add:2} blocks away and they work again ([[computer/seal_field]]).
